modes.title: Chat modes
modes.reasoningHint: Show the model's reasoning in Thought blocks when the runtime streams them.
modes.effortNote: Effort is a prompt instruction here: this runtime exposes no native ACP effort parameter, so it asks the model to reason more or less thoroughly. It is not a provider setting.
modes.skillsHint: Allow skill picker and /skill commands for this session. Off strips skill tokens before sending.
modes.filesWorkspaceHint: Allow workspace file access and attachments for this session. Off drops attachments before sending.
modes.filesOffAttachmentsDropped: Attachments were not sent: Files is off for this session.
modes.codeExecutionHint: Allow terminal and host commands. Off auto-declines execution permission requests. On keeps the existing allowlist and ask-on-miss approvals — it never turns approvals off.
modes.memoryHint: Allow long-term memory search (FTS by default) for this session.
modes.useBrowserHint: Allow the managed browser and web_fetch for pages you ask about. Visited pages appear in the activity list below.
modes.webSearchHint: Single search plus fetch for this session, with cited sources.
modes.deepResearchHint: Multi-step fetch, compare, and synthesis, ending with a Sources list of pages actually fetched.
modes.imageGenerationHint: Allow image generation through the agent's existing image path. Off instructs the agent not to generate images.
modes.voiceMultimodalHint: Show voice dictation and file/image upload controls. Off hides them and drops attachments before sending.
modes.showUncensoredHint: Show uncensored models in this session's model picker. They are local-only and are never the default. This opt-in is per session and resets when the app restarts.
modes.hiddenUncensored: {{count}} uncensored models are hidden until you turn this on in Chat modes.
modes.autonomyHint: Supervised is the default. Full Autonomy continues multi-step tasks unattended within hard boundaries — it never auto-approves a dangerous action.
modes.autonomyFullWarning: Full Autonomy is bounded: dangerous actions still pause for your approval, and genuine blockers stop the task instead of being worked around. See the scope note below.
modes.scopeNote: Scope: these switches are per session. They send a session instruction with each prompt and gate input in the composer. They do not change global runtime configuration (tools.deny, exec allowlist, ask-on-miss policy).
modes.browserLimit: Browser limit: there is no live computer-use viewport in this draft — no clicking or typing into pages, and no live page preview. Browser use here is fetch/navigate plus the activity list below.
modes.webSearchLimit: Search limit: web_search is denied in the global runtime config, so search steps fall back to web_fetch of explicit URLs and say so. No source is ever invented.
modes.browserActivityEmpty: No browser or fetch activity in this session yet.
